# Trace Labs

Trace Labs is a GitHub-inspired Obsidian theme adapted for the Trace Labs OSINT virtual machine. The recorded description says that it keeps familiar GitHub styling while adding layout and visual tweaks for a developer-focused workspace, and it records nothing about supported modes, settings or plugins.

![Trace Labs screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/humandecoded/Trace-Labs-Obsidian-Theme/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Trace Labs"
    author: "humandecoded"
    repo:   "humandecoded/Trace-Labs-Obsidian-Theme"
    slug:   "trace-labs"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/trace-labs"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/humandecoded/Trace-Labs-Obsidian-Theme"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/humandecoded/Trace-Labs-Obsidian-Theme/HEAD/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark"]
    about: "Apply a GitHub-inspired Obsidian theme adapted for the Trace Labs OSINT VM. Keep familiar GitHub styling while adding layout and visual tweaks for a clean, developer-focused workspace."
}
```
